description: Update an existing GitLab project's settings, visibility, features, and CI/CD configuration. Requires Maintainer or Owner; some settings require Owner, administrator access, a paid tier, or a newer GitLab version. Only supplied settings are changed. Topics replace existing topics. Avatar accepts an image URL to upload. To clear an array, send an empty array in a separate call without avatar.
